recommendation: Usable small external composition-transfer check. Limited to seven composition/environment groups; insufficient by itself to resolve broad model performance.
target_definition: Potential where anodic current density reaches 100 microA/cm2; experimental pitting observed by SEM.
excluded_reason: Sheet 6d industrial S32205 has 16 targets but a separately identified industrial bulk-composition table was not located. Do not assume laboratory heat compositions.

registry_overlap.scope: DOI/title source-level check; not numerical row deduplication.

missingness_policy: P/S absent in Table 6; Cu dash in two S32750 rows; unreported trace elements remain unknown. Fe reported as balance. No generic grade composition substituted.
remaining_preprocessing_detail: Electrolyte is described as double-concentration simulated seawater following Xin and Li 2014 (10.1016/j.corsci.2013.12.004). Exact salt recipe/molar species have not been verified; do not equate seawater to pure NaCl.
limitations: Seven independent input conditions despite 56 replicate targets.
Nb-induced inclusion modification is not explicitly represented in the current feature schema; a targeted scientific challenge, not proof of broad interpolation.

broader_candidate.availability: Data will be made available on request. Not downloaded, not ready for evaluation.
broader_candidate.independence: Mixed literature and original experiments; independent original Epit subset count not verified.
